records.source: I feel inspired today... I think I'll do some writing.
records.translation: May inspirasyon ako ngayon... Sa tingin ko ay magsusulat ako.

records.source: The sound of rain, in some tiny way, reminds me of my cabin by the beach.#$e#The farm is wonderful, but I do miss the sound of the ocean.
records.translation: Bahagyang ipinaaalala sa akin ng tunog ng ulan ang Kubo ko sa tabi ng dalampasigan.#$e#Kahanga-hanga ang bukid, pero nami-miss ko ang tunog ng karagatan.

records.source: I got up early and made coffee.[395]#$e#I find that a cup of this exquisite brew makes the early morning a lot more pleasant.
records.translation: Maaga akong bumangon at nagtimpla ng kape.[395]#$e#Napansin kong ginagawang mas kaaya-aya ng isang tasa ng napakasarap na timplang ito ang maagang umaga.

records.source: I think I'll remain indoors today, my dear. The rain causes my hair to go limp.
records.translation: Sa loob lang ako ngayon, mahal ko. Pinapalaylay ng ulan ang buhok ko.

records.source: My inspiration for writing is like the weather... it comes and goes at random. Today I feel entirely dull.$s#$e#Perhaps I'll read one of the classics to get my creative juices flowing.
records.translation: Tulad ng panahon ang inspirasyon ko sa pagsusulat... dumarating at umaalis nang walang tiyak na dahilan. Wala akong kasigla-sigla ngayon.$s#$e#Marahil ay magbabasa ako ng isa sa mga klasiko upang muling dumaloy ang pagkamalikhain ko.

records.source: Ah, what a lovely day to read a book... don't you think, my dear?
records.translation: Ah, napakagandang araw para magbasa ng aklat... hindi ba, mahal ko?

records.source: Good evening. Did you have a productive day, @?^Good evening. Did you have a productive day, my dear?
records.translation: Magandang gabi. Naging mabunga ba ang araw mo, @?^Magandang gabi. Naging mabunga ba ang araw mo, mahal ko?

records.source: You're ice cold! Let me keep you warm.$l
records.translation: Napakalamig mo! Hayaan mong painitin kita.$l

records.source: My skill with words is unmatched, yet I can't find the way to properly describe your allure.$l^My skill with words is unmatched, yet I can't find the way to properly describe your beauty.$l
records.translation: Walang kapantay ang husay ko sa mga salita, pero hindi ko pa rin mailarawan nang wasto ang halina mo.$l^Walang kapantay ang husay ko sa mga salita, pero hindi ko pa rin mailarawan nang wasto ang kagandahan mo.$l

records.source: What did I do today? I'll just say this... it takes a lot of work to maintain this rugged physique!
records.translation: Ano ang ginawa ko ngayon? Ito lang ang sasabihin ko... napakaraming pagsisikap ang kailangan upang mapanatili ang matipunong pangangatawang ito!

records.source: I spent the afternoon daydreaming about the ocean. So I decided to cook some seafood. [198 202 727 728]$h
records.translation: Ginugol ko ang hapon sa pangangarap nang gising tungkol sa karagatan. Kaya nagpasiya akong magluto ng pagkaing-dagat. [198 202 727 728]$h

records.source: I've been taking much better care of myself now that we're together. The bachelor life wasn't particularly healthy for me.
records.translation: Di-hamak na mas mabuti kong inaalagaan ang sarili ko ngayong magkasama tayo. Hindi gaanong naging malusog para sa akin ang buhay-binata.

records.source: Good morning, @! I made us a pot of coffee.[395]#$e#I find myself craving this robust flavor nearly every morning.
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @! Nagtimpla ako ng isang pitsel ng kape para sa atin.[395]#$e#Halos tuwing umaga ay hinahanap-hanap ko ang matapang na lasang ito.

records.source: If you find a spider in the house, don't squash it! Just let me know and I'll take the poor thing outside.
records.translation: Kung makakita ka ng gagamba sa bahay, huwag mo itong pisain! Sabihin mo lang sa akin at ilalabas ko ang kawawang nilalang.

records.source: Today is going to be a fantastic day... I can feel it!$h#$e#I get this special feeling in my nose...
records.translation: Magiging kamangha-mangha ang araw na ito... nararamdaman ko!$h#$e#May kakaiba akong nararamdaman sa ilong ko...

records.source: I've had this recurring nightmare that you gave me a buzz cut... You wouldn't ever do that to me, would you?$s#$e#I trust you.
records.translation: Paulit-ulit kong napapanaginipang ginupitan mo ako nang halos kalbo... Hindi mo gagawin iyon sa akin, hindi ba?$s#$e#Nagtitiwala ako sa iyo.

records.source: From the brightest winter star, to the shimmer of an iridium vein... nothing can compare to my wonderful man.$l^From the brightest winter star, to the fragrant fairy rose... nothing can compare with your captivating beauty.$l
records.translation: Mula sa pinakamaliwanag na Bituin ng Taglamig hanggang sa kislap ng ugat ng iridyum... walang maihahambing sa kahanga-hanga kong asawa.$l^Mula sa pinakamaliwanag na Bituin ng Taglamig hanggang sa mabangong Rosas ng Diwata... walang maihahambing sa mapang-akit mong kagandahan.$l

records.source: A crackling fire adds wonderful ambience to the house... every piece of wood burns in a unique way.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng kahanga-hangang kapaligiran sa bahay ang lagitik ng apoy... natatangi ang paraan ng pagliyab ng bawat piraso ng kahoy.

records.source: I never had much success growing plants in my old beach house. Hopefully I can pick up a thing or two by watching you.#$e#In this respect, you are the master and I only a humble apprentice.
records.translation: Hindi ako gaanong nagtagumpay sa pagpapatubo ng mga halaman sa dati kong bahay sa dalampasigan. Sana ay may matutuhan ako sa pagmamasid sa iyo.#$e#Sa bagay na ito, ikaw ang dalubhasa at ako ay isang hamak na baguhan lamang.

records.source: When I behold thy wondrous face, a precious jewel of form and grace, my heart... torn by the dread of night, is purified with golden light.#$e#Poetry is the only way I can begin to describe my feelings for you.$l
records.translation: Kapag minamasdan ko ang mukha mong marilag, isang mahalagang hiyas ng anyo at biyayang busilak, ang puso ko... pinupunit ng pangamba sa gabi, ay dinadalisay ng ginintuang liwanag.#$e#Sa tula ko lamang masisimulang ilarawan ang nararamdaman ko para sa iyo.$l

records.source: My love... I wouldn't trade you for 100 iridium bars.#$e#Nor 1000...#$e#Not even 10,000 bars, no.$7#$e#...$7#$e#No, not even 100,000 bars!$a#$e#...$s#$e#Wa... one million bars of pure iridium...? Don't make me do this...$8
records.translation: Mahal ko... Hindi kita ipagpapalit sa 100 lingote ng iridyum.#$e#Kahit sa 1000...#$e#Kahit sa 10,000 bareta, hindi.$7#$e#...$7#$e#Hindi, kahit sa 100,000 bareta!$a#$e#...$s#$e#Isa... isang milyong bareta ng purong iridyum...? Huwag mo akong piliting mamili...$8

records.source: My wildest dreams have come true... just look at this incredible landscape!
records.translation: Nagkatotoo na ang pinakamalalaking pangarap ko... tingnan mo lang ang kahanga-hangang tanawing ito!

records.source: Fertile soil beneath my feet, fresh air to fill my lungs, and the sun's warmth to delight my skin... Life is going well.
records.translation: Matabang lupang nasa ilalim ng mga paa ko, sariwang hanging pupuno sa mga baga ko, at init ng araw na nagpapaligaya sa balat ko... Maganda ang takbo ng buhay.

records.source: I might stay here and write some poetry. I'm feeling a sudden surge of creativity! You go on ahead and take care of business.
records.translation: Baka manatili ako rito at magsulat ng tula. Nararamdaman ko ang biglang bugso ng pagkamalikhain! Mauna ka na at asikasuhin ang mga gawain mo.

records.source: If I stay perfectly still, perhaps a resplendent butterfly will bless my nose with a landing.
records.translation: Kung hindi ako kikilos kahit kaunti, marahil ay dadapo sa ilong ko ang isang maringal na paruparo.

records.source: I drank too much coffee... my mouth feels about as dry as the Calico Desert.$s#$e#Oh... sorry about the coffee breath.$7
records.translation: Naparami ang inom ko ng kape... Parang kasintuyo ng Disyerto ng Calico ang bibig ko.$s#$e#Ah... pasensiya na sa hiningang amoy-kape.$7

records.source: Have you had any time to entertain little %kid1 today? Maybe a second child will make things easier for both of us.
records.translation: Nagkaroon ka ba ng oras na aliwin ang munting si %kid1 ngayon? Baka maging mas madali para sa ating dalawa kapag may pangalawang anak.

records.source: Little %kid1 is going to have the perfect childhood here. There's so much to explore.
records.translation: Magkakaroon ng perpektong pagkabata rito ang munting si %kid1. Napakaraming matutuklasan.

records.source: Caring for babies isn't exactly my strong suit... but I'll do my best to be a good father.
records.translation: Hindi talaga ako mahusay sa pag-aalaga ng mga sanggol... pero gagawin ko ang lahat upang maging mabuting ama.

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their food. They eat a lot for such small creatures!
records.translation: Napakain ko na sina %kid1 at %kid2. Napakalakas nilang kumain para sa gayong kaliit na mga nilalang!

records.source: I was carrying %kid1 earlier, and I could've sworn I heard a "Da...da".$h
records.translation: Karga ko kanina si %kid1, at maipapanunumpa kong narinig kong sinabi niya ang “Pa...pa”.$h

records.source: I'm going to teach %kid1 to read as soon as possible! That's a great way for children to learn about the world.
records.translation: Tuturuan kong magbasa si %kid1 sa lalong madaling panahon! Napakagandang paraan niyan para matutuhan ng mga bata ang tungkol sa mundo.

records.source: We've done well, @. The farm is doing excellent and our healthy children are a great joy. I couldn't be happier.
records.translation: Mahusay ang nagawa natin, @. Napakaganda ng takbo ng bukid at malaking ligaya ang malulusog nating mga anak. Wala na akong mahihiling pa.

records.source: @... I'm so proud of all your hard work. I'm very lucky to have you.$l
records.translation: @... Labis kong ipinagmamalaki ang lahat ng pagsisikap mo. Napakapalad kong kapiling ka.$l

records.source: I made a whole secret book of poems expressing my love for you.$l
records.translation: Gumawa ako ng isang buong lihim na aklat ng mga tulang nagpapahayag ng pagmamahal ko sa iyo.$l

records.source: I came to the valley to find the ivory tower from which my talents could reign supreme. But what I really found was a dungeon of loneliness. You saved me from that.$l
records.translation: Dumating ako sa lambak upang hanapin ang toreng garing kung saan makapaghahari nang kataas-taasan ang mga talento ko. Pero isang piitan ng kalungkutan ang talagang natagpuan ko. Iniligtas mo ako mula roon.$l

records.source: Wow, you look really handsome today! Did you shave? Your jawline is perfect.$l^Your feminine allure is irresistible today. I can't keep my eyes off you.$l
records.translation: Grabe, napakakisig mo ngayon! Nag-ahit ka ba? Perpekto ang hugis ng panga mo.$l^Hindi malabanan ang halina mo ngayon. Hindi ko maalis ang tingin ko sa iyo.$l

records.source: I feel burnt out in your absence. But when I hear that sound of muddy boots on wood, my heart rises from the ash.
records.translation: Nauubos ang sigla ko kapag wala ka. Pero kapag naririnig ko ang tunog ng mapuputik na botang tumatapak sa kahoy, bumabangon ang puso ko mula sa abo.

records.source: I'm doing a walking meditation. It's good for creativity.
records.translation: Nagmumuni-muni ako habang naglalakad. Mabuti ito para sa pagkamalikhain.

records.source: Be careful out there! I do worry about you sometimes. There are people in the world who would take advantage of you.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Nag-aalala rin ako sa iyo minsan. May mga tao sa mundo na maaaring magsamantala sa iyo.

records.source: I think I'll walk down to the beach today. It's always nice to see the ocean again.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko ay maglalakad ako papunta sa dalampasigan ngayon. Laging masarap makita ulit ang karagatan.

records.source: I had a nice time at the beach by myself. I watched the waves come and go, just like old times.
records.translation: Naging masaya ako nang mag-isa sa dalampasigan. Pinanood ko ang pagdating at pag-alis ng mga alon, gaya noong araw.

records.source: My new year's resolution is to write, write, and write! I can never stop improving my skills.
records.translation: Ang pangako ko sa bagong taon ay magsulat, magsulat, at magsulat! Hindi ako dapat tumigil sa pagpapahusay ng mga kakayahan ko.

records.source: It's strange, but I often have cravings for pomegranate in the spring.
records.translation: Kakaiba, pero madalas akong natatakam sa granada kapag tagsibol.

records.source: I look forward to dancing with you tomorrow, my dear.
records.translation: Inaasam kong makasayaw ka bukas, mahal ko.

records.source: It's hard to be in a foul mood when the sun is beaming and the butterflies are dancing on a spice-berry breeze.$h
records.translation: Mahirap sumimangot kapag nagniningning ang araw at sumasayaw ang mga paruparo sa simoy na may halimuyak ng Mabangong Bunga.$h

records.source: I was going to grab an extra bottle of ink from my cabin today, but then I remembered the Luau is tomorrow. I'll just do it then.
records.translation: Kukuha sana ako ngayon ng isa pang bote ng tinta sa Kubo ko, pero naalala kong bukas na ang Luau. Saka ko na lang kukunin iyon.

records.source: All good things must come to an end, including the joyful days of summer. The key to happiness is to accept change without judgment.
records.translation: Kailangang magwakas ang lahat ng mabuting bagay, pati ang masasayang araw ng tag-init. Ang susi sa kaligayahan ay tanggapin ang pagbabago nang walang paghatol.

records.source: The splendor of fall... a verdant banquet for all the senses to enjoy... has inspired some of the greatest poetry of all time.
records.translation: Ang karilagan ng taglagas... isang luntiang piging para sa lahat ng pandama... ang nagbigay-inspirasyon sa ilan sa mga pinakadakilang tula sa lahat ng panahon.

records.source: I might set my pride aside and sink my eager teeth into a sloppy, saucy barbecue sandwich tomorrow.
records.translation: Baka isantabi ko ang dangal ko at sabik na kagatin ang makalat at hitik-sa-sarsang sandwich na barbekyu bukas.

records.source: Would you still love me if I guzzled two gallons of pumpkin ale at the Spirit's Eve festival? Sometimes a man has primitive urges...
records.translation: Mamahalin mo pa rin ba ako kung lalagok ako ng dalawang galon ng ale na kalabasa sa pista ng Bisperas ng mga Espiritu? Minsan ay may mga likas na pagnanasa ang isang lalaki...

records.source: Winter is a great time to read books and play the piano. Remember to pause and enjoy a quiet moment or two.
records.translation: Magandang panahon ang taglamig para magbasa ng mga aklat at tumugtog ng piyano. Tandaang huminto at masiyahan sa isa o dalawang tahimik na sandali.

records.source: I'm a little out of practice, but I plan on entering the fishing contest tomorrow! You've got some stiff competition, dear.
records.translation: Medyo kulang ako sa ensayo, pero balak kong sumali sa paligsahan sa pangingisda bukas! Mahigpit ang magiging kalaban mo, mahal.

records.source: Happy new year's eve, my dear. Please accept this to celebrate. [348]
records.translation: Maligayang bisperas ng bagong taon, mahal ko. Tanggapin mo sana ito para magdiwang tayo. [348]
